g.text: Shelter Map - User & Verification (Core with providers)
confirm(user : RegisteredUser, pending : PendingVerification, code : String) : boolean
confirm(user : RegisteredUser, pending : PendingVerification, code : String) : boolean
confirm(user : RegisteredUser, pending : PendingVerification, code : String) : boolean
confirm(user : RegisteredUser, pending : PendingVerification, code : String) : boolean
confirmVerification(user : RegisteredUser, level : VerificationLevel, code : String) : boolean
register(name : String, email : String, phone : String, nationalIdCode : String) : RegisteredUser
Community rating IS the moderation - one review per user per shelter
(unique constraint on shelterId + userId). Re-rating = update, not insert.
Comments with text = the comment section (no separate entity in v1).
User submissions are created ACTIVE immediately - nothing to approve,
there is no moderator. Quality is governed by community ratings
(ShelterReview) instead. PENDING/REJECTED reserved for future use.
ABSTRACT main class - common to ALL users (every kind IS-A User).
Subclasses are kinds of user, fixed at creation:
RegisteredUser = account holder, becomes verified over time
Verification is NOT a subclass: a user can become verified AFTER
creation, and objects never change class (TIJ Ch 1/7). So
verification = claims (data), like the wing colour of a pigeon.
Rules as data (config, not code) - change without rebuilding:
VIEW_MAP -> baseline (no claims needed; guests can watch)
SUBMIT_SHELTER -> EMAIL or PHONE or SMART_ID
Answer = baseline + union of byLevel[level] for each active level.
